Klasse ChannelManager

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.shared.protocol.channelManager.ChannelManager
public class ChannelManager extends Object
Manages logical communication channels between a client and the server.

The ChannelManager is the core of the GolfIt reliable delivery system. It maintains four channels (CH_SYSTEM, CH_CHAT, CH_MOVEMENT, CH_PINGS), two of which are reliable and two unreliable:

  • Reliable channels (CH_SYSTEM, CH_CHAT): packets are acknowledged by the receiver. Unacknowledged packets are retried every TIMEOUT_MS milliseconds up to MAX_RETRIES times.
  • Unreliable channels (CH_MOVEMENT, CH_PINGS): packets are sent once with no acknowledgement or retry.

The same ChannelManager class is used on both the client and server side. The sender lambda is the only difference — on the client it sends to the server, on the server it sends back to a specific client.

  • Methodendetails

    • send

      public void send(String packetType, String channelId, int senderId, String payload) throws Exception
      Sends a message on the specified channel.

      Assigns the next sequence number for the channel, builds the message string, and transmits it via sender. If the channel is reliable, the packet is stored in the channel's pendingAck map and will be retried by tick() until acknowledged or the retry limit is reached.

      Parameter:
      packetType - the message type constant (e.g. Protocol.SYS_CONNECT)
      channelId - the channel to send on (e.g. Protocol.CH_SYSTEM)
      senderId - the ID of the sender
      payload - the message payload; may be empty but not null
      Löst aus:
      Exception - if the sender throws during transmission

    • tick

      public void tick() throws Exception
      Drives the retry logic for reliable channels. Should be called every ~100ms.

      For each reliable channel, iterates over all unacknowledged packets. If a packet has been waiting longer than TIMEOUT_MS:

      • If retryCount >= MAX_RETRIES, the packet is dropped
      • Otherwise, it is retransmitted and its retry counter is incremented
      Löst aus:
      Exception - if the sender throws during retransmission

    • onPacketReceived

      public void onPacketReceived(String raw) throws Exception
      Processes a raw incoming packet string.

      Parses the raw string into a MessageParser.Message. Then:

      • If the message is SYS_ACK, removes the matching sequence from pendingAck and returns — no further processing.
      • If the channel is reliable, checks whether this is a new (non-duplicate) packet via Channel.isNewPacket(int). Duplicates are silently discarded. For new packets, an ACK is sent back automatically.
      • Dispatches the message to the registered dispatcher.
      Parameter:
      raw - the raw UTF-8 message string received from the network
      Löst aus:
      Exception - if ACK sending or dispatching throws

    • sendAck

      private void sendAck(String channelId, int ackSequence, int targetId) throws Exception
      Sends a SYS_ACK back to the sender for a received packet on a reliable channel.

      The ACK carries the same sequence number as the packet being acknowledged, so the sender can remove it from its pendingAck map.

      Parameter:
      channelId - the channel the original packet arrived on
      ackSequence - the sequence number being acknowledged
      targetId - the ID of the original sender
      Löst aus:
      Exception - if the sender throws during transmission

    • resetChannels

      public void resetChannels()
      Resets all channels to their initial state.

      Clears sequence counters, pending ACKs, and seen-sequence history for every channel. Should be called on reconnect to allow sequence numbers to restart from 0.
